name: The Gray Neck
source:
This is an adaptation of a fairy tale for children, about a duck named Gray Neck.

The other birds flew south, and the Gray Neck was left alone. She couldn't fly away with everyone because her wing was broken.

[From [url=https://hloramin.itch.io/the-grey-neck]Itch.io[/url]]
